e.title: **把「谁在什么情况下可以写这一格」写成四列四条规则**：一个美国死亡率分解项目（Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22650711`，v0.1.4）——**它把**引用**、**出处**、**人工核签**、**他方佐证**拆成**四件不同的事****；**⭐ 逐字**「**A number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it. An automated fetch does not solve that; it changes the costume.**」**；**⭐ 自动化抓取**永远不能**写 `verified_by`**，**故一次成功的抓取之后**`UnverifiedDataError` 仍然会抛**；**⭐ 并逐字写明**空白不等于失败****
e.title_en: Writing who may fill which cell, and under what claim, as four columns and four rules: a US mortality decomposition project archived on Zenodo at version 0.1.4 separates citation, provenance, human attestation and third-party corroboration into four different things, states verbatim that a number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it and that an automated fetch does not solve that but changes the costume, guarantees that no machine path can write the attestation column so that an unverified-data error still fires after a successful fetch, and states verbatim that a blank corroboration field means not corroborated rather than failed.
e.title_hk: **把「誰在什麼情況下可以寫這一格」寫成四欄四條規則**：一個美國死亡率分解專案（Zenodo DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22650711`，v0.1.4）——**它把**引用**、**出處**、**人工核簽**、**他方佐證**拆成**四件不同的事****；**⭐ 逐字**「**A number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it. An automated fetch does not solve that; it changes the costume.**」**；**⭐ 自動化抓取**永遠不能**寫 `verified_by`**，**故一次成功的抓取之後**`UnverifiedDataError` 仍然會拋**；**⭐ 並逐字寫明**空白不等於失敗****
e.summary: **mortality-analysis**（`terryfinberg/mortality-analysis`；**Zenodo 记录** `22650711`，**DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22650711`）**是一个美国 2010–2024 年死亡率分解项目**：**用** Kitagawa 方法**把粗死亡率的变化拆成**年龄别死亡率**与**人口年龄结构**两部分**，**并测量这十五年间**四个口径边界**（**CDC WONDER 逐年口径、**2023 年的 Vintage 2024 重述、**2010 年 4 月 1 日基准、**2017／2018 的 bridged-race 到 single-race 接缝**）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「存证」**，**它是四条里把**证据等级**写得最细的一条**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把四件事拆成四列、四种「谁可以写」**——**按** `source_citation`（**引用**，**由导出文件页脚派生**）／`fetched_from`（**出处**，**由抓取脚本写**）／`verified_by`（**人工核签**，**逐字**「**a human, only**」）／`corroborated_against`（**他方佐证**，**同样只允许人写**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字说明为什么必须拆**——**「**A number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it. An automated fetch does not solve that; it changes the costume. A run against the wrong dataset, or the right dataset with a wrong filter, writes an impeccably precise `fetched_from` string onto a wrong number, and does so more convincingly than a hand transcription would.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它保证机器**写不了**核签那一格**——**逐字**「**no machine path in this repository can write `verified_by`, and a test asserts it against a temporary directory rather than against the current CSVs**」**，**且**一次成功抓取之后**`UnverifiedDataError` 仍会抛**；**⭐⭐ ④ 它也规定**改了就要撤销签名****（**改引用或覆写数值都会清空 `verified_by`**，**理由逐字为**「**a signature was made against what the old citation claimed**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ **空白 = 未佐证，不等于失败****（**逐字**「**A blank `corroborated_against` means not corroborated. It does not mean corroboration failed**」**）**，**并要求**部分佐证就写成部分**（**逐字**「**Partial corroboration stated as partial is worth more than complete attestation to a standard met on a sample.**」**）**；**⚠️ 本次未运行、未读任何数据行**。
e.summary_hk: **mortality-analysis**（`terryfinberg/mortality-analysis`；**Zenodo 記錄** `22650711`）**是一個美國 2010–2024 年死亡率分解專案**：**用** Kitagawa 方法**把粗死亡率變化拆成**年齡別死亡率**與**人口年齡結構**，**並測量四個口徑邊界**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「存證」**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把四件事拆成四欄、四種「誰可以寫」**（`source_citation`／`fetched_from`／`verified_by`／`corroborated_against`，**後兩者逐字**「**a human, only**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字說明為什麼必須拆**——**「**A number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it. An automated fetch does not solve that; it changes the costume.**」**；**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它保證機器**寫不了**核簽那一格**（**逐字**「**no machine path in this repository can write `verified_by`, and a test asserts it against a temporary directory rather than against the current CSVs**」**）**；**⭐⭐ ④ 改了引用或覆寫數值就會清空 `verified_by`**（**逐字理由**「**a signature was made against what the old citation claimed**」**）**；**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ **空白＝未佐證，不等於失敗****。**⚠️ 本次未運行、未讀任何資料列**。
e.summary_en: The project at `terryfinberg/mortality-analysis`, archived on Zenodo under a version DOI, **decomposes United States mortality between 2010 and 2024**: it splits the change in the crude death rate into an age-specific mortality component and a population age-structure component using the Kitagawa method, and it measures rather than assumes four denominator boundaries inside that single fifteen-year series, namely the per-year vintage chain carried by one national data product, a restatement of one year under a later vintage, an earlier measurement basis, and a race-bridging seam. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and of the four it writes evidence levels in the most detail**: it splits four things into four columns with four different rules about who may write them, covering citation derived from the export footer, provenance written by the fetch script, human attestation which verbatim only a human may write, and third-party corroboration which likewise only a human may write; it states verbatim why the split is necessary, that a number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it, that an automated fetch does not solve that but changes the costume, and that a run against the wrong dataset or the right dataset with a wrong filter writes an impeccably precise provenance string onto a wrong number more convincingly than a hand transcription would; it guarantees that no machine path in the repository can write the attestation column and that a test asserts this against a temporary directory rather than against the current data, so an unverified-data error still fires after a successful fetch; it clears the attestation whenever the citation or the value changes, on the reasoning that a signature was made against what the old citation claimed; and it states verbatim that a blank corroboration field means not corroborated rather than failed, and that partial corroboration stated as partial is worth more than complete attestation to a standard met on a sample. **Nothing was run and no data row was read this round.**
e.body:
**mortality-analysis**（GitHub 仓库 `terryfinberg/mortality-analysis`；**Zenodo 记录** `22650711`）**是一个美国死亡率分解项目**，**标题逐字为**「**Decomposing U.S. Crude Death Rates, 2010-2024: Population Aging Dominates, and the Denominator Is Not Stable**」。**本次实测**：**Zenodo 记录** —— **DOI 逐字为** `10.5281/zenodo.22650711`**、概念 DOI 为** `10.5281/zenodo.22263667`**、**版本** `v0.1.4`**、**类型** Software**、**许可** BSD-3-Clause**、**创建与更新均为 2026-09-07**、**1 个文件**（**逐字名为** `terryfinberg/mortality-analysis-v0.1.4.zip`**）**、**作者** `Finberg, Terry`（**附 ORCID** `0009-0006-1598-4200`**）**、**关联标识逐字为** `https://github.com/terryfinberg/mortality-analysis/tree/v0.1.4`（**关系** `isSupplementTo`，**即**指向**打上版本标签**的那一次提交**）**；**GitHub 仓库** —— **创建 2026-09-01、最后推送 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**语言 Python**；**文件实测**：`README.md` 31,176 字节、`STATUS.md` **53,244 字节**、`UAT_CHECKLIST.md` 19,073 字节、`docs/denominator-methods.md` 31,398 字节、`LICENSE` 2,202 字节（**BSD-3-Clause**）**。**本条目属于本轮主题**「**存证：编号、版本、许可，以及把每个数追回它的来源**」**；**本词条认为它是本会话迄今为止**把「**证据等级**」写得最细的一条**——**⭐ 其做法与本词条项目自身的纪律**高度同构**。

**可核实信息（均 README、`STATUS.md` 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把四件事拆成四列，并规定每列**谁可以写****——**README 有一节标题逐字为**「**Provenance, attestation and corroboration are three different columns**」（**⭐ 注意标题说 three，而表里是四列——本文照原文引用，并在下文如实列出四行**），**表头逐字为** `Column`／`The claim`／`Who may write it`，**四行逐字为**：**① **`source_citation`**——主张逐字**「**What this value is a copy of. The export’s footer `Dataset`, its query parameters, access date and sha256**」**，**写入者逐字**「**derived from the footer by `export_citation()`**」；**② **`fetched_from`**——主张逐字**「**Provenance. `wonder-export:<filename>@sha256:<hash>`**」**，**写入者逐字**「**`src.fetch.promote()`**」；**③ **`verified_by`**——主张逐字**「**Attestation. A person confirmed this value matches the cited export**」**，**写入者逐字**「**a human, only**」；**④ **`corroborated_against`**——主张逐字**「**Corroboration. A separate publication reports the same figure, e.g. an NVSR volume and table. Not independent: see the note below**」**，**写入者同样逐字**「**a human, only**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**这一格是谁写的**」**被写成表的一列**，**而不是靠约定——**⭐ 而四列的**四种主张**分别是：**我抄的是哪一份文件**、**这份数据是怎么来的**、**有人核过它与该文件一致**、**另有出版物报了同一个数**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字说明为什么必须拆开**——**逐字**：**「**This split is the point, not bookkeeping. A number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it. An automated fetch does not solve that; it changes the costume. A run against the wrong dataset, or the right dataset with a wrong filter, writes an impeccably precise `fetched_from` string onto a wrong number, and does so more convincingly than a hand transcription would.**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「**带着引用的数字看起来就像被核过**」**——**这是本词条见过的对「**引用的暗示力**」最准确的一句描述**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「**自动抓取并没有解决问题，它只是换了一身衣服**」（**changes the costume**）**——**⭐ 即**自动化提高了**可信的外观**，**而没有提高**可信度**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「**跑错数据集、或对的数据集配错的筛选条件，会把一个精确到无可挑剔的出处字符串写在一个错的数字上，而且比手工转录更有说服力**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮四条里**最重要的一句**：**它说的不是「人会出错」，而是「**机器出错时更像对的**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它保证机器**写不了**核签那一格，而且用测试把这个「**不可能**」钉住**——**逐字**：**「**So `verified_by` is never machine-written. `src.fetch.promote()` fills `source_type`, `fetched_from` and `source_citation`, and leaves `verified_by` blank, which means **`UnverifiedDataError` still fires after a successful fetch**. Promotion gets the numbers into place; it does not sign them off. You do that, row by row, and the loader will not run in strict mode until you have.**」**；**另一处逐字**：**「**no machine path in this repository can write `verified_by`, and a test asserts it against a temporary directory rather than against the current CSVs**」**。**⭐ 三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 抓取成功后仍然报「未核实」**——**即**「**数据到位**」与「**数据被核签**」**是两个状态**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ 严格模式在你逐行核签之前**跑不起来**——**⭐ 即**核签是**前置条件**，**而不是**事后补的文档**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 那条测试**针对临时目录**断言，**而不是针对当前那份 CSV**——**⭐ 即**它测的是「**机器写不了**」这条**规则本身**，**而不是「**这一份文件当前恰好没有被机器写**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 改动必须**撤销签名****——**逐字两处**：**「**If `promote()` rewrites a row’s `source_citation`, it clears `verified_by` too: **a signature was made against what the old citation claimed.**」**与**「**If `promote()` overwrites a value you had already signed off on, it clears your `verified_by` for that row. **Your attestation was about the old number.**」**。**⭐ 即**签名**绑定**在「**当时那个引用与那个数值**」上**——**⭐ 数值或引用一变，**签名自动作废**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它把「**空**」的含义写死，并要求部分佐证就承认是部分**——**逐字**：**「**A blank `corroborated_against` means not corroborated. It does not mean corroboration failed, and the loader never requires it. Partial corroboration stated as partial is worth more than complete attestation to a standard met on a sample.**」**；**并逐字说明「**这不是独立确认**」**：**「**It is corroboration, not independent confirmation. NVSR and WONDER are both NCHS products drawing on the same mortality file and the same Census-derived denominators. Agreement rules out a real class of error, namely a query returning the wrong slice, and says nothing about whether the underlying NCHS data is right.**」**。**⭐ 即**它区分了**三件事**：**未佐证**（**空白**）、**佐证失败**（**不存在这种状态**）、**同源机构之间的一致**（**不构成独立确认**）——**⭐ 本词条认为这与本站第 337 轮「**没有任何东西能站在单一来源上**」是同一族纪律，**而这里更进一步**：**它连「**两个来源一致**」也要追问这两个来源**是不是同一只手**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑥ 佐证的**实际程度被逐条写明**，且**弱主张保持弱**——**次节逐字给出**：**十五个年度总计中的**十三个（2010–2022）**与对应 NVSR《Deaths: Final Data》报告的 Table B **完全一致**，**且计算出的粗死亡率与 NVSR 公布的率在**一位小数**上一致**；**2023 年的**计数**经 NVSR 74-11 佐证，**但其**率**未获佐证**（**逐字理由**「**because that report computes rates on a different population basis, at a precision too coarse to discriminate ours**」**）**；**2024 年**没有任何已发表来源**（**逐字**「**2024 has no published source at all, and blank means not corroborated rather than failed**」**）**；**并逐字说明列的设计意图**「**`corroborated_measures` records which measures each row’s source actually confirmed, so the weaker claim stays visibly weaker.**」。**⭐ 即**「**计数被佐证**」与「**率被佐证**」**被分开记**，**故**弱的那一个不会看起来和强的一样**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 两处「**这个项目当前到哪**」的自我交代**——**README 开头逐字**：**「**Repository status: populated, attested, and running. Corroboration against NCHS’s published reports is partial and deliberately labelled as such: 14 of 15 annual totals.**」**（**⭐ 注意此处写 14，而正文写「**十三个 2010–2022 一致，**2023 的计数亦被佐证**」——**本词条把两处都如实转述，不替它调和**）**；**并指向** `STATUS.md`（**实测 53,244 字节**）**逐字说明它写的是**「**where the project stands, what is still open and in what order, and the known limits stated plainly**」**；**另有** `UAT_CHECKLIST.md`（19,073 字节）**与** `docs/denominator-methods.md`（31,398 字节）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 可核对性是**字节级**的**——**README 逐字**：**「**Inputs are four committed CDC WONDER exports and three U.S. Census population vintages. Each export carries WONDER’s own query-parameter footer and a SHA-256 that the test suite recomputes, so a reviewer receives the exact bytes the results were computed from**」**；**并逐字说明原始导出文件是**故意提交**的**（**「**The raw CDC WONDER export files in `data/raw/wonder_exports/` are **committed deliberately**, not by accident. They are the reproducibility artifact**」**）**。**⭐ 即**「**可复现**」在这里的具体含义是：**评审者拿到的是**当时算过的那些字节**，**而测试套件会**重算 SHA-256**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 抓取路径本身也被约束**——**逐字给出三个子命令**（`--discover`／`--reconcile`／`--check`**，**其中** `--check` **逐字为**「**as `--reconcile`, exit non-zero on >0.5% drift**」**）**，**并逐字说明**「**Nothing in the fetch path writes to `data/raw/*.csv`; parsed output lands in `data/raw/fetched/` and only the explicit, default-dry-run `promote()` copies it across.**」**；**另有两条**「**不变量**」**逐字**：**「**Both exact identities: `sum(bands) + not_stated == annual deaths`, and `sum(bands) == annual population`, for all 15 years, with no tolerance.**」**与**「**The external check: the crude rate computed from these CSVs reproduces WONDER’s own published Crude Rate column for all 15 years.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑩ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[human-mortality-db]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demography]]、[[mortcast]] 覆盖死亡率数据与方法**，**[[great-expectations]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[verified-reserving]] 覆盖数据校验与可复现性**，**[[reliability-harness]] 覆盖「**怎么知道它可靠**」**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**证据等级的分栏**：**引用、出处、人工核签、他方佐证四件分开**，**且每件都规定**谁能写**。**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**其主题（**美国死亡率与分母口径**）与本站主线**直接相关**，**但本次**未读任何数据行、未运行任何命令**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 应当并读**——**它给的是**结论**（**人口老化主导粗死亡率上升，**尽管年龄别死亡率在改善**）**与**方法论**（**Kitagawa 分解、**四个分母口径边界**）**；**⭐ 而它对本站最有价值的是那**四列**：**把「**谁可以写这一格**」写进表结构**，**并让机器**写不了**核签那一栏**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未跑 bootstrap、未跑测试、未跑 `src.fetch` 或 `src.report`、未读任何 CSV 行**），**故不主张**其分解结果、佐证比例或数据不变量**按所述成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读 `STATUS.md`、`UAT_CHECKLIST.md`、`docs/denominator-methods.md` 的正文**（**本次只读其存在与字节数**），**故不主张**其中列出的未决事项、检查单与分母方法论细节。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实那些**外部断言**：**未访问 NVSR 的任何报告或表格、**未访问 CDC WONDER、**未核对「**十三个年度总计一致**」与「**2023 计数被佐证**」这两处说法**，**也未核实它自己指出的**「**NCHS 曾在两份报告中给出两个不同的 2020 年粗死亡率**」**这一说法**。**④ ⚠️ README 内部有一处**数字不一致**（**开头写 14 of 15，正文写十三个完全一致＋2023 计数亦被佐证**）**——**⭐ 本词条如实记录，**不替它调和、**也不据此判定谁对**（**可能口径不同**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实那条「**测试断言机器写不了 `verified_by`**」是否真的存在**（**未读测试代码**）**——**⭐ 本词条只转述原文**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与该项目是否与任何机构有关**；**★0 不构成质量证据**。**⑦ ⚠️ 许可为 BSD-3-Clause**（**Zenodo 字段与仓库 `LICENSE` 一致**），**本次**未读许可正文**。**⑧ ⚠️ Zenodo 记录创建 2026-09-07 与仓库推送 2026-09-07 都在解冻窗口之内**，**故本条不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但本词条如实指出**：**「**四列证据等级 ＋ 机器不能写核签 ＋ 改动即撤销签名 ＋ 空白不等于失败**」这一组合，此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引号约定**：**本条目逐字引用英文原文时，把原文里的 ASCII 撇号（如 `export’s`、`row’s`、`NCHS’s`）写作 ’**——**以维持本词条不出现 ASCII 单引号的约定（引文内容未改）**。

**mortality-analysis**（GitHub 倉庫 `terryfinberg/mortality-analysis`；**Zenodo 記錄** `22650711`）**是一個美國死亡率分解專案**，**標題逐字為**「**Decomposing U.S. Crude Death Rates, 2010-2024: Population Aging Dominates, and the Denominator Is Not Stable**」。**本次實測**：**Zenodo 記錄** —— **DOI 逐字為** `10.5281/zenodo.22650711`**、概念 DOI 為** `10.5281/zenodo.22263667`**、**版本** `v0.1.4`**、**類型** Software**、**許可** BSD-3-Clause**、**建立與更新均為 2026-09-07**、**1 個檔案**、**作者** `Finberg, Terry`（**附 ORCID**）**、**關聯標識逐字為** `https://github.com/terryfinberg/mortality-analysis/tree/v0.1.4`（**關係** `isSupplementTo`**）**；**GitHub 倉庫** —— **建立 2026-09-01、最後推送 2026-09-07**、**★0**、**Python**；**檔案實測**：`README.md` 31,176 位元組、`STATUS.md` **53,244 位元組**、`UAT_CHECKLIST.md` 19,073 位元組、`docs/denominator-methods.md` 31,398 位元組、`LICENSE` 2,202 位元組**。**本條目屬於本輪主題**「**存證**」**；**本詞條認為它是本會話至今**把「**證據等級**」寫得最細的一條**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、`STATUS.md` 與檔案清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把四件事拆成四欄，並規定每欄**誰可以寫****——**表頭逐字為** `Column`／`The claim`／`Who may write it`，**四行逐字為**：`source_citation`（**主張**「**What this value is a copy of. The export’s footer `Dataset`, its query parameters, access date and sha256**」**，**寫入者**「**derived from the footer by `export_citation()`**」）、`fetched_from`（**出處**，**寫入者** `src.fetch.promote()`）、`verified_by`（**核簽**，**寫入者逐字**「**a human, only**」）、`corroborated_against`（**佐證**，**同樣**「**a human, only**」）**。**⭐ 即**「**這一格是誰寫的**」**被寫成表的一欄**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它逐字說明為什麼必須拆開**——**逐字**：**「**This split is the point, not bookkeeping. A number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it. An automated fetch does not solve that; it changes the costume. A run against the wrong dataset, or the right dataset with a wrong filter, writes an impeccably precise `fetched_from` string onto a wrong number, and does so more convincingly than a hand transcription would.**」**。**⭐ 三處值得記**：**① 「**帶著引用的數字看起來就像被核過**」；**② 「**自動抓取沒有解決問題，只是換了一身衣服**」（**changes the costume**）；**③ 「**跑錯資料集、或對的資料集配錯篩選，會把精確到無可挑剔的出處字串寫在錯的數字上，而且比手工轉錄更有說服力**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 它保證機器**寫不了**核簽那一格**——**逐字**：**「**So `verified_by` is never machine-written. `src.fetch.promote()` fills `source_type`, `fetched_from` and `source_citation`, and leaves `verified_by` blank, which means **`UnverifiedDataError` still fires after a successful fetch**. Promotion gets the numbers into place; it does not sign them off.**」**與**「**no machine path in this repository can write `verified_by`, and a test asserts it against a temporary directory rather than against the current CSVs**」**——**⭐ 即**那條測試測的是「**規則本身**」，**而不是「**這一刻恰好沒被寫**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 改動必須**撤銷簽名****——**逐字**：**「**If `promote()` rewrites a row’s `source_citation`, it clears `verified_by` too: **a signature was made against what the old citation claimed.**」**與**「**Your attestation was about the old number.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 它把「**空**」的含義寫死**——**逐字**：**「**A blank `corroborated_against` means not corroborated. It does not mean corroboration failed, and the loader never requires it. Partial corroboration stated as partial is worth more than complete attestation to a standard met on a sample.**」**；**並逐字說明這不是獨立確認**（**NVSR 與 WONDER 同屬 NCHS、同一個死亡檔案與同一套人口分母**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑥ 佐證的實際程度逐條寫明，且**弱主張保持弱****——**十五個年度總計中**十三個（2010–2022）**與 NVSR 表 B **完全一致**；**2023 年的**計數**被佐證而**率**未獲佐證**（**逐字理由**「**that report computes rates on a different population basis, at a precision too coarse to discriminate ours**」**）**；**2024 年**無任何已發表來源**（**逐字**「**blank means not corroborated rather than failed**」**）**；**並逐字說明**「**`corroborated_measures` records which measures each row’s source actually confirmed, so the weaker claim stays visibly weaker.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 兩處自我交代**——**README 開頭逐字**「**Repository status: populated, attested, and running. Corroboration against NCHS’s published reports is partial and deliberately labelled as such: 14 of 15 annual totals.**」**（**⭐ 此處寫 14，**正文寫十三＋2023 計數**——**本詞條照實轉述，不替它調和**）**；**並指向** `STATUS.md`（53,244 位元組）**逐字說明它寫的是**「**where the project stands, what is still open and in what order, and the known limits stated plainly**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 可核對性是**位元組級**的**——**逐字**「**Each export carries WONDER’s own query-parameter footer and a SHA-256 that the test suite recomputes, so a reviewer receives the exact bytes the results were computed from**」**，**並逐字說明原始匯出檔是**故意提交**的**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 抓取路徑本身也被約束**（`--discover`／`--reconcile`／`--check`，**後者逐字**「**exit non-zero on >0.5% drift**」**）**，**並逐字說明**「**Nothing in the fetch path writes to `data/raw/*.csv`; parsed output lands in `data/raw/fetched/` and only the explicit, default-dry-run `promote()` copies it across.**」**；**另有兩條不變量逐字**（`sum(bands) + not_stated == annual deaths`、`sum(bands) == annual population`，**for all 15 years, with no tolerance**）。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[rki-excess-mortality]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]] 應當並讀**——**它給的是**結論**與**方法論**；**⭐ 而它對本站最有價值的是那**四欄**：**把「**誰可以寫這一格**」寫進表結構**，**並讓機器**寫不了**核簽那一欄**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**，**故不主張**其分解結果、佐證比例或資料不變量**按所述成立**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀 `STATUS.md`、`UAT_CHECKLIST.md`、`docs/denominator-methods.md` 正文**（**只讀其存在與位元組數**）。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實任何外部斷言**（**未訪問 NVSR、CDC WONDER**，**未核對十三個年度一致、2023 計數佐證、以及 NCHS 曾給出兩個不同的 2020 粗死亡率**）。**④ ⚠️ README 內部有一處**數字不一致**（14 of 15 對十三＋2023**）——**如實記錄，不調和、不判定**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實那條「**測試斷言機器寫不了 `verified_by`**」是否真的存在**（**未讀測試程式碼**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與機構關聯**；**★0 不構成品質證據**。**⑦ ⚠️ 許可為 BSD-3-Clause，未讀正文**。**⑧ ⚠️ Zenodo 記錄建立與倉庫推送均為 2026-09-07，在解凍窗口之內**，**故本條不需要窗口例外**；**⭐ 但「四欄證據等級＋機器不能寫核簽＋改動即撤銷簽名＋空白不等於失敗」此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。 **⑩ ⚠️ 引號約定**：**本條目逐字引用英文原文時，把原文裡的 ASCII 撇號（`export’s`、`row’s`、`NCHS’s`）寫作 ’**——**以維持本詞條不出現 ASCII 單引號的約定（引文內容未改）**。

The project at `terryfinberg/mortality-analysis`, archived on Zenodo, **decomposes United States crude death rates between 2010 and 2024**, with the full title stating that population aging dominates and that the denominator is not stable. **Measured this round**: on the Zenodo side, a version DOI, a concept DOI, **version 0.1.4**, resource type Software, **licence BSD-3-Clause**, **created and updated on 2026-09-07**, **a single file**, a creator with an ORCID, and one related identifier marked as supplementing a version-tagged GitHub path; on the GitHub side, **created 2026-09-01**, **last pushed 2026-09-07**, zero stars, Python, with a README of 31,176 bytes, **a status file of 53,244 bytes**, a user acceptance checklist of 19,073 bytes, a denominator methods document of 31,398 bytes and a licence file of 2,202 bytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of evidence and citability, and this project writes evidence levels in more detail than anything else encountered this session.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the status file and the file listing**: **first, it splits four things into four columns and states who may write each.** The table headers are column, the claim, and who may write it. Citation is the claim about what the value is a copy of, derived from the export footer including its dataset name, query parameters, access date and SHA-256 hash, written by a derivation function. Provenance is a string recording the source export filename and hash, written by the fetch promotion step. Attestation is the claim that a person confirmed the value matches the cited export, and corroboration is the claim that a separate publication reports the same figure, and **both of those two may be written by a human only**. **Who wrote this cell is a column of the table rather than a matter of convention**, and the four claims are distinct: what file I copied, how this datum came to be here, whether anyone checked it against that file, and whether another publication reports the same number. **Second, it states verbatim why the split is necessary**: the split is the point rather than bookkeeping, because a number carrying a citation looks verified whether or not anyone verified it; an automated fetch does not solve that but changes the costume; and a run against the wrong dataset, or the right dataset with a wrong filter, writes an impeccably precise provenance string onto a wrong number and does so more convincingly than a hand transcription would. **This entry considers those three sentences the most important of the round, because the point is not that people make mistakes but that machines make mistakes that look correct.** **Third, it guarantees that no machine path can write the attestation column, and pins that impossibility with a test.** Verbatim, the attestation column is never machine-written, the promotion step fills the source type, provenance and citation fields and leaves attestation blank, which means an unverified-data error still fires after a successful fetch, promotion gets the numbers into place but does not sign them off, the reader does so row by row, and the loader will not run in strict mode until then. A second passage states that no machine path in the repository can write the attestation column and that a test asserts this against a temporary directory rather than against the current data files, **so what is tested is the rule rather than the accident that the current file happens to be unmarked**. **Fourth, changing anything clears the signature**: if the promotion step rewrites a citation it also clears the attestation, because a signature was made against what the old citation claimed, and if it overwrites a value that had been signed off it clears that attestation too, because the attestation was about the old number. **Fifth, it defines what blank means and insists that partial corroboration be labelled partial.** Verbatim, a blank corroboration field means not corroborated, it does not mean corroboration failed, and the loader never requires it; partial corroboration stated as partial is worth more than complete attestation to a standard met on a sample. It also states verbatim that this is corroboration rather than independent confirmation, because the two national sources are products of the same agency drawing on the same mortality file and the same census-derived denominators, so agreement rules out a real class of error and says nothing about whether the underlying data is right. **Three states are therefore distinguished: not corroborated, corroboration failed, which does not exist as a state, and agreement between two sources that are not independent.** **Sixth, the actual extent of corroboration is written out claim by claim, and the weaker claim is kept visibly weaker**: thirteen of fifteen annual totals between 2010 and 2022 match a table in the corresponding published final-data report exactly, and the computed crude rate matches the published rate to one decimal in all thirteen; the 2023 count is corroborated but not its rate, because that report computes rates on a different population basis at a precision too coarse to discriminate; 2024 has no published source at all, and blank means not corroborated rather than failed; and a dedicated column records which measures each row source actually confirmed, **so that the weaker claim does not end up looking like the stronger one**. **Seventh, two statements about where the project stands**: the README opens by describing the repository as populated, attested and running, with corroboration against the published reports partial and deliberately labelled as such, and points at a status file described verbatim as covering where the project stands, what is still open and in what order, and the known limits stated plainly, alongside a user acceptance checklist and a denominator methods document. **Eighth, checkability is at the byte level**: the inputs are four committed data product exports and three census population vintages, each export carries the data product own query-parameter footer and a SHA-256 that the test suite recomputes, so a reviewer receives the exact bytes from which the results were computed, and the raw exports are committed deliberately rather than by accident, described as the reproducibility artefact. **Ninth, the fetch path is itself constrained**: three subcommands offer discovery, reconciliation, and a check that exits non-zero on more than half a percent drift; nothing in the fetch path writes to the raw data files, parsed output lands in a separate fetched directory, and only an explicit, default-dry-run promotion copies it across; and two invariants are stated with no tolerance, that summed age bands plus an unspecified remainder equal annual deaths and that summed bands equal annual population, across all fifteen years, together with an external check that the computed crude rate reproduces the published crude rate column for every year. **Tenth, relative to existing entries**: the pooled mortality data and method entries supply sources and techniques, the pooled validation and reproducibility entries supply data checking, and the pooled reliability entry discusses how to know something is trustworthy, while **this entry supplies the grading of evidence into columns, with a rule for who may write each and a guarantee that the machine cannot sign.** **The subject matter of US mortality and denominator definitions is directly relevant to this wiki main line, but no data row was read and no command was run this round.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside [[rki-excess-mortality]] and [[cmi-mortality-projections]]**, because **it supplies both a conclusion and a method**, and because **the four columns are the most transferable part: make who may write this cell part of the table structure, and make it impossible for the machine to sign the attestation column**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no bootstrap, no test suite, no fetch and no report — **so its decomposition results, its corroboration fractions and its data invariants are not claimed to hold as described**. **Second, the bodies of the status file, the acceptance checklist and the denominator methods document were not read**, only their existence and byte counts, **so the open items, checkpoints and methodological detail they contain are not claimed; this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, no external assertion was verified**: no published final-data report was visited, the national data product was not visited, and neither the claim of thirteen matching annual totals nor the corroborated 2023 count nor the claim that the agency itself published two different crude death rates for one year was checked. **Fourth, the README contains one internal numerical inconsistency**, describing corroboration as covering fourteen of fifteen totals in one place and as thirteen matching totals plus a corroborated count in another, **which this entry records without reconciling or adjudicating, since the two may use different definitions**. **Fifth, whether a test really asserts that no machine path can write the attestation column was not verified**, because no test code was read; the passage is relayed only. **Sixth, the creator identity and any institutional affiliation were not verified**, and zero stars is not evidence of quality. **Seventh, the licence is BSD-3-Clause by both the archive metadata and the repository licence file, whose text was not read. Eighth, both the archive record and the repository push fall on 2026-09-07 inside the thaw window, so no window exception is needed; however, the combination of four graded evidence columns, a machine that cannot sign, signatures cleared on change, and a blank that means not corroborated rather than failed had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11. Tenth, quotation convention: ASCII apostrophes appearing inside quoted English were rendered as curved apostrophes so that this entry contains no ASCII single quote, with the quoted text otherwise unchanged.**
